about_the_game:
Virum: Colony

The world has plunged into chaos after a global catastrophe. Ruined cities, irradiated wastelands, and scorched lands have become the new home for the remaining survivors. Scattered colonies build shelters, seize abandoned structures, and struggle to restore a sense of order amidst the ruins. Your goal is to establish a thriving settlement — providing your people with shelter, food, and security.

As time passes, you'll expand your colony by constructing new buildings to adapt to the harsh environment. But survival won't be easy — you'll face infections, raider attacks, and countless other threats lurking at every turn. Every decision matters: how you manage production, which buildings you prioritize, and how you defend your people will determine your colony's fate.

Some survivors may leave your colony — forging their own hideouts that may become allies or rivals. Others might be infected, slowly turning into a threat to those around them. The world is alive and changing, and your actions will shape its future.

Game Features:

  • Life in a ruined world — build your settlement while exploring and adapting abandoned zones for survival.

  • Seize and rebuild — reclaim old structures to strengthen your colony’s infrastructure.

  • Defense and danger — fortify your territory and fend off threats like raiders, mutants, or deadly diseases.

  • Growth and survival — expand your colony with new buildings that boost production, resource gathering, and security.

  • Economy and resources — manage limited resources, optimize your layout, and ensure long-term sustainability.

  • Dynamic world events — witness survivors leaving to start their own factions or becoming threats from within.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/ Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD FX4300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 560 or R7 260
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/ Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Storage: 4 MB available space
